entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I just need the return authorization.

I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I have your order number? And just to make sure I'm processing this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

The issue is I don't need it anymore. Look, my husband bought it right before his military deployment was scheduled. But there was a medical emergency, and he ended up in the hospital. He had to have surgery, so the deployment is off and he can't use this. The box hasn't even been opened.
Oh my, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope he's recovering well. Thank you for explaining. Let me just pull up your order to check the return eligibility. When was the item delivered?
Around December 15th. It was a while ago, things have been chaotic.
I completely understand. One moment please while I check that for you... Okay, I see the order was delivered on December 15th, which was 29 days ago.
According to our policy here, items can be returned within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and process that full refund for you right now.
Great. So you're sending a shipping label to my email?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return. You should receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next few minutes. Just pack it up, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
You're very welcome. I hope everything gets better for your husband. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
